pairs: At the departure of Israel from Egypt,
the house of Jacob from a barbarous people:
The Jordan was turned back again.
and the hills like lambs among the sheep.
so that you were turned back again?
O mountains, so that you exulted like rams, and to you,
O hills, so that you exulted like lambs among the sheep?
A facie Domini mota est terra,
Before the face of the Lord, the earth was moved,
before the face of the God of Jacob.
qui convertit petram in stagna aquarum,
He converted the rock into pools of water,
and the cliff into fountains of waters.
but to your name give glory.
super misericordia tua et veritate tua;
Give glory to your mercy and your truth,
But our God is in heaven.
All things whatsoever that he has willed, he has done.
The idols of the nations are silver and gold,
the works of the hands of men.
Neither will they cry out with their throat.
Similes illis fiant qui faciunt ea,
Let those who make them become like them,
et omnes qui confidunt in eis.
along with all who trust in them.
The house of Israel has hoped in the Lord.
adjutor eorum et protector eorum est.
He is their helper and their protector.
The house of Aaron has hoped in the Lord.
adjutor eorum et protector eorum est.
He is their helper and their protector.
Qui timent Dominum speraverunt in Domino;
Those who fear the Lord have hoped in the Lord.
adjutor eorum et protector eorum est.
He is their helper and their protector.
The Lord has been mindful of us,
He has blessed the house of Israel.
He has blessed the house of Aaron.
He has blessed all who fear the Lord,
May the Lord add blessings upon you:
Blessed are you by the Lord,
The heaven of heaven is for the Lord,
but the earth he has given to the sons of men.
The dead will not praise you,
neque omnes qui descendunt in infernum:
and neither will all those who descend into Hell.
But we who live will bless the Lord,
ex hoc nunc et usque in sæculum.
